change.ir_action: The bounded torch pulse now requests one YUV frame for in-memory analysis and discard instead of calling the save-to-private-storage capture action.
change.pulse_completion: The helper is signalled as soon as the YUV buffer is delivered, before CPU analysis, so illumination need not remain on while the analyzer processes pixels.
change.failure_cleanup: Capture failure, frame-reader exception, activity close and the 850 ms app timeout clear the pending frame operation; the helper retains its independent 1 s watchdog and off-on-disconnect trap.
